ncab9602cea.headline: Jumia, now worth almost R50-billion, looks beyond profit target
ncab9602cea.summary: Jumia Technologies, valued near R50 billion, is focusing on long-term growth by planning to spin off divisions and enter new African markets beyond short-term profitability.
ncab9602cea.why: Jumia is a leading African e-commerce platform, and its strategic moves impact the development of digital commerce and investment opportunities across the continent.
